title: Asset ingestion & branding pipeline for product screenshots
creator: Ravi Menon
description:
Problem: Release screenshots for onboarding, quickstarts and docs leak inconsistent branding and occasionally surface PII or localized layout breakage. We need an automated pipeline that ingests raw UI exports (PNG/SVG), produces brand-consistent variants (desktop/mobile/compact), applies privacy-safe redaction, enforces safe crops for multiple aspect ratios, and outputs localization-safe assets for docs and product pages.

Scope: Implement a design-led pipeline that: (1) standardizes naming and metadata; (2) runs automated PII detection (email, phone, API keys, personal names) with configurable masking rules; (3) generates focused crops using design token-driven focus areas and fallback heuristics for dynamic UIs; (4) creates localized visual variants (ltr/rtl, truncated text overlays) and tests truncation points; (5) applies brand overlays (logo placement, color-safe borders) and contrast checks; (6) produces alt text suggestions and a QA checklist; (7) integrates with storage and release workflows (S3 + release tagging); (8) surfaces a manual review queue for top-tier marketing screens.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement on-device screenshot capture or replace the design system—it's an orchestration layer for assets. Full OCR fixes in product are tracked separately (ENG-3012).
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline ingests PNG/SVG inputs and outputs 3 variants (desktop, tablet, mobile) with predictable file names
Automated PII detection flags and masks at least emails, phone numbers, and API-like token patterns with a <1% false negative rate on the validation set
Safe-crop templates ensure primary CTA or highlighted component remains visible in all aspect ratios for 90% of sample screens
Localization variants produced for en/fr/de/ja/ar include RTL flip where appropriate and do not overflow visual containers in 95% of samples
Brand overlay module applies logo, border, and color profile according to design tokens and passes contrast checks (WCAG AA)
QA queue and generated metadata (source commit, component name, reviewer) are written to storage and surfaced in the design review dashboard
comments: 2026-03-10 - Kickoff: Aligned with PM on scope. Decided to prototype redaction using open-source OCR + regex heuristics; privacy team to validate masking rules.

2026-03-11 - Spike results: Prototype using Tesseract + heuristics produced fast results but poor confidence on small font; tested Google Vision API on 50 screens — better accuracy but cost tradeoffs. Action: compare two approaches on 200-screen set (Elena to lead).

2026-03-12 - Design decision: Use hybrid approach — first-pass open-source OCR for cheap/bulk, fallback to paid OCR for critical marketing screens flagged by heuristic score. PRD updated with cost model (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Brand+Screenshot+Pipeline).
2026-03-12 - Dependencies noted: ENG-3012 (product OCR hardening), ENG-2890 (asset storage + release tagging). Added review request for Privacy & Legal on masking policy (ticket sent to PRIV-22).
2026-03-12 - UX note: For RTL languages, we must mirror focus areas and run an automated visual diff against baseline to detect misalignment. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-12 - Dev hooks: Initial branch created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-screenshots/pull/34 — contains sample ingestion script and crop rules. Reviewers requested: @marco and @sana.
